title.value: JUNO Sensitivity to Invisible Decay Modes of Neutrons
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main focus and the majority of the content of the paper.
title.quote: JUNO Sensitivity to Invisible Decay Modes of Neutrons

analysis.description: The paper investigates the potential of the JUNO neutrino detector to detect invisible decay modes of neutrons, particularly in the context of baryon number violation. The study involves detailed simulations to estimate the backgrounds and sensitivities of these decay modes at the JUNO detector, aiming to improve the sensitivity limits compared to prior experiments. The analysis uses Monte Carlo simulations and develops strategies for event selection, muon veto, and background suppression using advanced techniques like pulse shape discrimination and multivariate analysis.

type.justification: The paper is based on detailed Monte Carlo simulations and experimental data analyses related to the JUNO detector to study neutron invisible decays.
type.quote: Based on a full Monte Carlo simulation informed with the latest available data, we estimate all backgrounds...

name.justification: The study is focused on neutron decay, which falls under the field of particle physics, particularly concerning baryon number violation aspects in experiments like JUNO.
name.quote: baryon number B is necessarily violated, and the proton must decay in the Grand Unified Theories (GUTs)... The neutron invisible decay has two modes: n → inv and nn → inv.

name.justification: The research specifically deals with experiments using neutrino detectors, like the JUNO detector, to measure decay processes and phenomena related to neutrinos.
name.quote: JUNO is a 20 kton multipurpose underground liquid scintillator (LS) detector under construction in China... The LS detectors have distinct advantages in the search for some nucleon decay modes, such as p → ν̄K+ and the neutron invisible decays.

name.justification: The paper makes extensive use of Monte Carlo simulations to estimate backgrounds and signal efficiencies in the JUNO detector.
name.quote: Based on a full Monte Carlo simulation informed with the latest available data, we estimate all backgrounds...

is_contributed.justification: The setup and execution of specific Monte Carlo simulations for this research contribute to the analysis and findings of the paper.
is_contributed.quote: A full MC simulation has been performed with the JUNO simulation framework...
